title: Floating Machi Koro-style central illustration spec — Novostroyka
purpose: Central cutout artwork for a blue Machi Koro-style card, depicting a culturally recognizable Saint Petersburg mass-housing new build.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the central illustration to composite onto the existing blank blue card template.
integration_context.background_requirement: A perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later removal. The background must be one uniform color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
integration_context.card_relationship: A compact floating miniature with generous padding, no card furniture, coin, icon, frame, header, footer, or skyline.
integration_context.text_policy: Absolute no-text rule: no letters, numbers, names, logos, signs, plaques, graffiti, license plates, labels, or pseudo-writing anywhere.

style_goal.primary_rule: Match original Machi Koro establishment art: cute tabletop-game miniature, chunky simplified geometry, clean outlines, sparse details, and one or two flat shading tones.
style_goal.secondary_rule: Express Russian urban bleakness through the architecture and palette, never through photorealism or gritty texture.
style_goal.core_formula: Cute floating board-game miniature plus the instantly recognizable new residential high-rises of Saint Petersburg's Parnas district.

visual_composition.perspective: Building faces slightly to the right in a readable three-quarter view, showing its front and right side.
visual_composition.shape: One compact tall residential slab, slightly shortened and widened for a readable card silhouette.
visual_composition.occupancy: Subject centered with generous empty chroma-key margin on every side; nothing clipped.
visual_composition.base: A tiny integral paved courtyard slab with only two or three simplified shrubs and one small modern playground shape.
visual_composition.floating_behavior: No surrounding cityscape or environment; the miniature and base are fully self-contained.

palette.saturation: low to moderate, harmonious with a blue card

content.subject: A classic 2010s mass-market Saint Petersburg novostroyka apartment tower inspired by the dense high-rise housing of Parnas.
content.description: A toy-like 18-to-25-story precast residential slab with repetitive window grids, enclosed balcony stacks, alternating pale facade panels, a flat roof, and a dark ground-floor entrance.
content.desired_read: Immediately recognizable as a generic newly built residential tower from a huge Saint Petersburg sleeping district, not a Soviet five-story panelka and not a luxury skyscraper.
recognition_details: dense repetitive grid of small simplified windows across a tall broad facade
vertical stacks of glazed enclosed balconies shown as dark blue-gray blocks
patches of off-white, gray, dusty beige, and restrained orange facade panels
flat utilitarian roof with two or three simple rooftop utility boxes
tiny paved courtyard base emphasizing the immense building scale
simplify: suggest many floors with rhythmic window rows rather than drawing every window
render balconies as a few strong vertical bands
use only major panel divisions and large clean color fields
omit: all signage, developer branding, addresses, shopfront lettering, plaques, advertisements, cars, license plates, and human figures
photorealistic facade texture, fine balcony railings, air-conditioner clutter, cranes, construction site equipment, surrounding towers, sky, clouds, cast shadow, and reflections
content.target_impression: The same cheerful board-game illustrator was asked to portray the intimidating scale and monotonous comfort of Parnas without changing the cute miniature technique.

quality_rules.silhouette: Readable at small card size, with the tower clearly distinct from the tiny base.
quality_rules.linework: Clean outlines and sharp form separation; sparse interior lines.
quality_rules.shading: Simple graphic shading only, no cinematic light or architectural visualization.
quality_rules.background_removal: Crisp subject edges, no cast/contact shadow, no green spill, and no detached green-colored elements inside the silhouette.

anti_patterns: Do not generate a full card or a full city scene.
Do not make a short Soviet panelka, historic Petersburg building, luxury glass tower, or construction site.
Do not include any text-like marks on any surface.
Do not use photorealism, heavy texture, complex landscaping, weather, or atmospheric background.
final_prompt_summary: Create a single isolated Machi Koro-style floating miniature of a classic 2010s Saint Petersburg Parnas novostroyka: a broad 18-to-25-story mass-market precast apartment slab, facing slightly right in three-quarter view, with rhythmic small window rows, vertical enclosed-balcony bands, pale gray/off-white panels, restrained beige and orange accents, flat roof utility boxes, and a tiny integral paved courtyard base. Keep it cute, chunky, low-detail, cleanly outlined, and graphically shaded—not realistic. Put it on a perfectly uniform solid #00ff00 chroma-key background with generous padding and no shadows, gradients, scenery, or clipping. Do not use green in the subject. Absolute no-text rule: no letters, numbers, signs, logos, addresses, plaques, graffiti, license plates, labels, or pseudo-writing. Generate the building cutout source only, never the card.
